hebrewText: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְ/בָבֶ֤ל זָרִים֙ וְ/זֵר֔וּ/הָ וִ/יבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֑/הּ כִּֽי הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛י/הָ מִ/סָּבִ֖יב בְּ/י֥וֹם רָעָֽה

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

tokens.bdb: Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be aforeigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery
tokens.kjv: (come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange(-r, thing, woman).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanation: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanationEn: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner

tokens.bdb: to toss about; by implication, to diffuse, winnow
tokens.kjv: cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow.

tokens.bdb: to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine)
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.

tokens.bdb: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
tokens.kjv: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, [phrase] displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), [phrase] exceedingly, [idiom] great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), [phrase] mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, [phrase] not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).
